measure: Central bank policy rate, monthly, end of period
notes: XM = euro area (ECB rate), applies to DEU/FRA/ITA from 1999. DEU/FRA/ITA series: national BIS WS_CBPOL rates to 1998-12, then the XM euro-area values copied unchanged from 1999-01. Status B at 1999-01 marks the break from national rate to euro-area rate. Months with no published national rate are null, never zero.
